visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a beige polo shirt, sits on a grey sofa in a bright, modern living room. She holds a pink spatula and a glass lid with a bear-shaped knob, smiling at the camera. In front of her on a light-colored wooden coffee table is an array of cream and pink cookware, including a large round storage bag with a 'NEOFLAM' logo and a bear graphic. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of the cookware set laid out on a grey surface. It includes a pink wok, a white frying pan, a rectangular tamagoyaki pan, a detachable handle, and two pink silicone spatulas. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the smooth texture of the ceramic coating on the pans. (3) A series of cooking clips follows: First, broccoli and mushrooms are tossed in the pink wok; then, meat and mushrooms are stir-fried in the white pan next to a plate of sliced zucchini. The camera is positioned at a high angle, focusing on the movement of the pink spatula and the steam rising from the fresh vegetables. (4) The woman is shown washing the pink pan in a stainless steel sink under running water, demonstrating its easy-clean property. The camera then cuts to her covering the wok with a glass lid while cooking leafy greens on a black glass stovetop. The environment is a clean, well-lit domestic kitchen. (5) A technical demonstration shows the detachable handle being clicked onto the side of the pink pan. This is followed by a stacking demonstration where the various pans and trays are nested inside each other and then placed into the circular storage bag, emphasizing space-saving efficiency. (6) Further cooking scenes show a square yellow tamagoyaki being rolled in the rectangular pan, followed by beef rolls being seared in the pink wok. The final shot shows the woman standing up, carrying the white storage bag over her shoulder with a grey strap, showing its portability. (7) The video concludes with a group shot of the entire cookware set arranged on a kitchen counter and a close-up of the added pink spatula and ladle, with large text overlays describing a special offer and price points.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, female narrator speaking in Traditional Chinese with a high, bright pitch and friendly tone. Simultaneously, an upbeat acoustic guitar melody starts, featuring a steady strumming pattern at roughly 115 BPM. The vocal delivery is energetic and clear, filling the primary frequency range with high-quality studio-processed speech. (2) As the narrator describes the cooking features, subtle incidental sounds are heard: a soft metallic rustle and the faint percussive thud of a spatula hitting a ceramic pan. The background music remains constant in volume and tempo, providing a warm, major-key harmonic bed. (3) A brief sound of running water occurs, characterized by a broadband 'hissing' texture, appearing under the narration. The narrator's speed remains conversational but brisk, matching the visual montage. (4) A distinctive mechanical 'click' is heard as the detachable handle is demonstrated. The acoustic profile of this sound is sharp and short in duration, signifying a physical connection. The BGM guitar continues without interruption. (5) Towards the end of the video, a soft rustling sound of fabric/plastic is audible as the bag is handled and zipped. The narrator's tone becomes more persuasive, highlighting the price and offer, with a slight increase in arousal. The audio fades out smoothly with the music at the end of the clip.
